latin: Et si secunda trinitas deorum supermundanorum tota dicatur Proserpina, tamen prima eius unitas apud graecos dicitur Diana, secunda Persephone, tertia Minerua; apud barbaros uero, prima Hechate, secunda anima, tertia uirtus.
translation: And although the second triad of the supermundane gods is, as a whole, called Proserpina, its first unity is nonetheless called, among the Greeks, Diana; the second, Persephone; the third, Minerva. Among the barbarians, however, the first is called Hecate, the second Soul, the third Virtue.
